featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your feedback. We would like to clarify a few important points regarding the services and billing.
Before starting the services, the pricing was clearly informed:
• Normal shampoo + conditioner: ₹350
• Specialised dandruff shampoo + conditioner: ₹450
• Professional finishing blow dry: ₹895 per person
The invoice from our salon records clearly shows that the total bill included services for both mother and daughter, not just one person’s shampoo and blow dry.
Since the visit was before an engagement function, professional styling products including mousse, heat protector and finishing products were used to ensure the hair remained smooth, manageable and protected from the current extreme heat and humidity conditions outside due to ongoing heat waves.
The daughter’s hair was medium length with dry and frizzy texture, which required proper finishing techniques, blow dry styling and iron finishing for better results and longer hold.
We would also like to clarify that shampoo and blow dry are separate professional salon services in India, and our pricing is transparently mentioned in our salon price list.
We respectfully request that words like “cheated” not be used for a professional salon service. Saundarya Beauty Salon has been serving clients for almost 30 years with honesty, quality products and professional standards.
Every premium service involves professional products, skilled labour, time and finishing techniques according to the client’s hair texture, occasion and service requirement. We also provided a 10% discount on the final bill from our side.
Thank you for understanding.

It is high time the Chembur salon seriously upgrades its staff professionalism and hygiene standards. The management and owners need to step in immediately. If there are any authorities responsible for salon hygiene and service quality, this place definitely needs to be inspected.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently undergoing Laser Hair Reduction treatment at bodycraft chembur, and even though I am still in between my sessions, I have already seen drastic improvement in hair reduction. The results so far have been very encouraging.
Jayshree ma’am has been my assigned doctor, and my experience with her has been wonderful since day one. She is extremely humble, very sweet, and explains every step of the procedure clearly, which makes the entire process very comfortable and reassuring.
Her professionalism, patience, and friendly approach truly stand out. I feel confident and well taken care of during every session.
Overall, I am very happy with the treatment and the care provided, and I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone considering laser hair reduction.

She also got me set for my next treatment in a few days. Book your appointment ASAP! This is my favorite salon in India and I’ll be back as soon as possible
